fields.label: Current Journey Start
fields.description: The Harvesting entry that started this bucket's CURRENT journey -- i.e. the scan that flipped it Available -> In Use. Set once per journey (every Standard Roses harvest; only the first Spray Roses scan of a session). Receiving and Bucket Status use this to scope aggregation to the current journey only -- an earlier, abandoned journey's leftover unclaimed harvest entries must never be swept in: those stems were never received and the bucket has since moved on, so they're simply gone. Left blank means no journey marker was recorded yet (buckets mid-journey from before this field existed) -- callers fall back to their old unclaimed-aggregation behavior for those.
